edit_ops.detail: The 3x3 PCF is a box filter over 9 depth compares. A 2x2 bilinear-weighted compare (4 taps at half-texel offsets, weights from the fractional texel position) gives a comparable soft edge with 4 fetches; the visual difference is a slightly narrower penumbra.

hypothesis.claim: The 3x3 PCF is a box filter over 9 depth compares. A 2x2 bilinear-weighted compare (4 taps at half-texel offsets, weights from the fractional texel position) gives a comparable soft edge with 4 fetches; the visual difference is a slightly narrower penumbra.
hypothesis.predicted_cost: 9 -> 4 shadow fetches and compares per lit pixel
hypothesis.predicted_error: Penumbra width changes: FLIP nonzero on shadow edges; expected within budget on most scenes, not code-exact
